SRB.Daggerheart.HopeHint: The duality die of Hope. If it shows more than the Fear die, the roll is with Hope
SRB.Daggerheart.FearHint: The duality die of Fear. If it shows more than the Hope die, the roll is with Fear
SRB.Daggerheart.AdvantageHint: A d6 that is added to the total
SRB.Daggerheart.DisadvantageHint: A d6 that is subtracted from the total
SRB.Daggerheart.WithHopeHint: Hope {hope}, Fear {fear}: the Hope die is higher
SRB.Daggerheart.WithFearHint: Hope {hope}, Fear {fear}: the Fear die is higher
SRB.Daggerheart.CriticalHint: Hope and Fear show the same number, so the roll succeeds whatever the total is
SRB.Daggerheart.GuaranteedCriticalHint: An effect makes this roll a critical success
SRB.Daggerheart.ReactionHint: A reaction roll gives neither Hope nor Fear
SRB.Daggerheart.CriticalHitHint: A natural result in the critical range always hits
SRB.Daggerheart.CriticalDamageHint: A critical hit adds the highest possible result of every die
